_note: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the overworld map image format. Both tools/map_ascii_to_png.py and src/exploration/MapImageLoader.gd read THIS FILE. Do not transcribe these values into either one — a second copy is how a mapping silently drifts.
_format: One pixel per tile. The pixel encodes the MAP CHARACTER, not the tile type: _char_to_tile_type collapses 25 chars into ~12 visual types (all four dragon caves return CAVE_ENTRANCE), so a tile-type image cannot round-trip and would erase every landmark's spawn identity.
_authoring: Paint at 1px = 1 tile. Colours are exact-match; an unknown colour is a hard error naming its coordinate, never a silent fallback. Terrain colours are naturalistic so the map reads while painting; landmark colours are deliberately vivid and far apart in RGB because most landmarks are a SINGLE PIXEL and must survive a stray stroke being noticed.
